confirmation.title: Review the result

website_builder.title: Customize your website

editor_sections.title: Build with sections

live_preview.title: Preview as a customer

branding.title: Make it recognizably yours
branding.description: Set colors, typography and visual details while keeping accessible contrast and a consistent studio identity.

publish.title: Save, then publish
publish.description: Saving keeps a draft. Publishing makes the reviewed version visible to customers and remains permission protected.

memberships.title: Sell memberships, credits and vouchers
memberships.description: Understand plans, active members, customer credit and flexible vouchers.

plans.title: Design a membership plan
plans.description: Plans define price, validity, locations and included benefits. Publishing and sales actions remain permission protected.

customers.title: See active members
customers.description: The Customers tab shows who owns a plan, its current period and the benefits still available.

credits.title: Understand customer credit
credits.description: Membership benefit balances belong to a plan. Standalone customer credit is managed on the customer profile and can be used independently where enabled.

vouchers.title: Offer flexible gifts
vouchers.description: Voucher offers live beside the rest of the catalog, ready for customer purchase and redemption.

ai_reports.title: Use AI and reports
ai_reports.description: Turn studio activity into questions, recommendations and measurable trends.

assistant.title: Ask the Studio Assistant
assistant.description: Open the assistant for workspace-aware questions and explanations. It respects the same access boundaries as the rest of the dashboard.

advisor.title: Start with the overview
advisor.description: The report overview brings the most important studio signals together before you explore deeper sections.

report_filters.title: Set the reporting context
report_filters.description: Choose dates, location, comparison and granularity so every metric answers the same business question.

report_insights.title: Move from metrics to insight
report_insights.description: Use the report tabs and AI briefing where available to explain changes and identify the next useful action.

team_management.title: Manage your team
team_management.description: Learn how roles and location access keep workspace responsibilities clear.

members.title: Your workspace team
members.description: Each member has a role, status, profile and location scope that determines what they can see and do.

invite.title: Add the right person
invite.description: Team managers can add an existing workspace user and assign responsibilities in one controlled flow.

roles.title: Use roles deliberately
roles.description: Built-in and custom roles group permissions so access stays understandable as the studio grows.

location_access.title: Scope access by location
location_access.description: Limit a team member to selected studios when their work should not span every location.

door_access_codes.title: Manage door access codes
door_access_codes.description: Learn how to organize entrances, monitor stock, add codes and keep sensitive changes auditable.

scope.title: Know what Shario controls
scope.description: This is a secure inventory for codes already programmed into your physical locks. Shario does not program the lock or send codes by email in this phase.

entrances.title: Choose a location and entrance
entrances.description: Each code pool belongs to one studio location and one physical entrance or lock. Keep separate locks in separate pools.

stock.title: Watch code availability
stock.description: Summary cards show eligible, reusable, expiring and emergency codes. The low-stock threshold warns you before single-booking codes run out.

add_codes.title: Add codes safely
add_codes.description: Create one code directly or paste and import a CSV. Confirm a code is programmed and tested before making it available.

lifecycle.title: Manage each code’s lifecycle
lifecycle.description: Reveal a secret only when needed, edit its eligibility metadata, or retire it permanently when it should never return to the available pool.

audit.title: Keep sensitive actions accountable
audit.description: Audit history records creation, edits, reveals, imports and retirement without displaying plaintext codes.

first_offer.title: Publish your first offer
first_offer.description: Turn an Open Studio or class into a customer-ready offer.

offer_types.title: Choose what customers can book
offer_types.description: Use Open Studio for flexible studio access and Classes for scheduled teaching. The catalog shows only the offer types enabled for this workspace.

create_offer.title: Start from the catalog
create_offer.description: Create the offer from here after the guide. Launch Center keeps the first setup focused and returns you to the next useful step.

price_capacity.title: Set the booking essentials
price_capacity.description: Give the offer a clear name, price, capacity, location and availability so customers know exactly what they are reserving.

publish.title: Review before it goes live
publish.description: Save the offer, review how it will appear to customers and publish it only when the schedule and booking rules are ready.

test_customer_journey.title: Complete a test customer journey
test_customer_journey.description: Use safe Practice Mode to preview booking, confirmation and customer access.

public_site.title: Start from the customer view
public_site.description: Your published public site is where customers discover offers and begin booking. Practice Mode uses the same journey without changing live studio records.

test_booking.title: Try a safe booking
test_booking.description: Practice Mode walks through a simulated booking. It creates no real customer booking and makes no real payment.

confirmation_email.title: Preview the confirmation
confirmation_email.description: Review what a customer would be told after booking. Practice Mode sends no real email, so you can check the experience safely.

customer_portal.title: Preview customer access
customer_portal.description: See how the customer reaches their booking and studio information. Practice Mode uses temporary preview artifacts rather than a real customer account.

payments_setup.title: Set up payments
payments_setup.description: Connect Stripe and understand when customer payments are ready.

connection_status.title: See the verified connection status
connection_status.description: This status comes from the server and shows whether the Stripe account is not started, pending, restricted or active.

stripe_onboarding.title: Continue securely in Stripe
stripe_onboarding.description: The real onboarding happens on Stripe. When you return, Shario refreshes the backend status instead of assuming the account is ready.

payment_capabilities.title: Confirm charges and payouts
payment_capabilities.description: An active connection must be able to accept charges and receive payouts. These capabilities are reported directly by Stripe.

verify_payment.title: Verify the customer experience
verify_payment.description: After Stripe reports the account as active, use the safe customer Practice Mode before accepting a real booking. Practice Mode makes no real payment.

data_import.title: Import your existing studio
data_import.description: Move data in with validation, reports and a recoverable audit trail.

choose_importer.title: Choose the data type
choose_importer.description: Import customers, offers, bookings, memberships, credits or vouchers in a sensible order. Only areas enabled for your workspace appear.

template_upload.title: Use the template or your export
template_upload.description: Download a template or upload a CSV or Excel export. The mapping step lets you match existing columns without rearranging the source file first.

validation.title: Validate before changing data
validation.description: The dry run highlights invalid rows, duplicates and proposed changes. Nothing is imported until you review and confirm the result.

history_rollback.title: Keep an audit trail
history_rollback.description: History preserves reports for each import. Where records are still eligible, authorized users can preview and safely roll back tracked changes.

customer_communications.title: Set up customer communication
customer_communications.description: Review templates, reminders, test delivery and email history.

templates.title: Review the customer templates
templates.description: Templates keep confirmations and operational messages consistent. Check the wording and studio identity before enabling automation.

reminders.title: Configure useful reminders
reminders.description: Automations control when booking and studio messages are prepared. Keep timing relevant and avoid sending unnecessary messages.

test_email.title: Send a real setup test
test_email.description: Verify the sender identity first, then use Send test email from setup. The test confirms delivery without contacting a customer.

delivery_history.title: Check delivery history
delivery_history.description: History shows what was sent and whether delivery needs attention, giving the team one place to investigate communication issues.

navigation.description: Use the main navigation for reservations, customers, studio operations, sales, messages and reports. Empty areas will fill as your team starts working.

ai_assistant.title: Ask the AI Assistant
ai_assistant.description: Open the assistant to ask questions about your studio and get operational insights. If AI is not enabled for your plan or role, you can return to this step later.

settings.title: Settings and customization
settings.description: Manage configuration, branding, your public site, payments and team access here. Website Builder is where you shape what customers see.

final.title: You’re ready to start

one.question: What can I manage with Shario?
one.answer: Manage bookings, memberships, payments, locations, shared resources, your team and your public website. Enable the modules that fit your space.

two.question: Can I use my own branding?
two.answer: Yes. Customize your public website’s colors, typography, content and layout. Custom domains are available on eligible plans.

three.question: Can my customers book and manage their memberships?
three.answer: Yes. Your public website and customer portal connect bookings, purchases, memberships, credits and invoices.
